articles.headline: Tatum scores 41 to help Celtics snap 4-game skid with a 131-116 win over Wizards
articles.description: — Jayson Tatum scored 28 of his 41 points in the first half and the Boston Celtics snapped their four-game losing streak by beating the Washington Wizards 131-116 on Tuesday night.

articles.headline: Without Cade Cunningham, Pistons get 21 from Isaiah Joe to hand Magic their first NBA Cup loss
articles.description: — Isaiah Joe had 21 points and Daniss Jenkins added 15 to spur the Detroit Pistons past the Orlando Magic 104-86 in an NBA Cup game on Tuesday night.
